'''2014 Philadelphia Premiere Andrew Bollentino DS Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Bollentino]] at [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Andrew Bollentino]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Results

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-philadelphia-premiere-event-andrew-bolletino-ds-hdadtj/ PC list]
